components.name: Chart/Gauge
components.description: A single value on a bounded scale where the range itself matters (credit score, risk level). Default: value arc on dataviz/track; Zones: poor / fair / good bands with a needle. Always print the value and both bounds. For KPI vs target on dashboards prefer Chart/Bullet. React: <GaugeChart value min max zones? />
